title: 541. Total Hamming Distance

examples.explanation: Each pair differs in 2 bit slots, totalling 6.
Equal entries contribute 0; each 4 vs 14 contributes 2.

hints: Handle each bit column on its own instead of each pair.
If ones columns hold c ones among n numbers, that column adds c*(n-c).
Thirty-one columns cover values up to 10^9.
